title: Daily News Quiz · 2026-09-14
headline: IBM and NASA release an open-source artificial intelligence model to map the Moon

questions.prompt: Who released the new open-source model for studying the Moon?
questions.hintKo: The model came from IBM and NASA, not an airline or a museum.

questions.prompt: What can the model help scientists find on the Moon?
choices: Ice deposits, craters, and volcanic features
questions.hintKo: The model studies the Moon's surface features, not buildings or oceans.

questions.prompt: When did IBM and NASA announce the open-source release?
choices: On the tenth of September, twenty twenty-six
questions.hintKo: The release was announced on the tenth of September.

questions.prompt: Where are the model and its code available for researchers?
choices: Online, on sharing and code platforms such as Hugging Face and GitHub
questions.hintKo: The model is published online for anyone to use, not locked in an office.

questions.prompt: Why is finding ice on the Moon important for future missions?
choices: Ice is used to build roads
Ice provides water and oxygen for a Moon base and rocket fuel
questions.hintKo: Ice matters because it supports crew life and fuel, not because of museums.

questions.prompt: How much did the model reduce error when predicting areas with high potential for lunar ice?
choices: By up to twenty-two percent compared with an older model
It did not change the error at all
By fifty percent on the ground
questions.hintKo: The improvement was up to twenty-two percent lower error, not a total fix.
